subject: Re: HITNet kickoff - staffing + compute plan
body:
Dmitri,

Staffing and compute for the window:

- Wei 50% (eval + metrics), Umar 30% (Middlebury/ETH3D analysis), Rosa 40% (data ingest, then serving glue), Bilal 40% (infra).
- Farah Haddad is committed at 60% to HITNet for June 2026 - she leads the custom CUDA op work that the latency milestone depends on, and I've blocked her calendar accordingly.
- Compute is light: 16 titan-a100 GPUs best-effort covers eval and latency runs. No Vulcan ask.

Rationale on Farah: the released models use default tensorflow ops and run 3x slower than the custom-op variants, so the June real-time demo lives or dies on that port. She's our only person who's shipped custom CUDA kernels recently.

Budget-wise this fits inside the existing data-platforms envelope; no incremental headcount ask.

Deshawn
